entries.name: field
entries.description: The unique identifier of the column. Used to map with [[GridRowModel]] values.

entries.name: aggregable
entries.description:
If `true`, the column is aggregable in the column header.
If `false`, the column is only aggreble programmatically, if the list of aggregation functions is available.

entries.name: aggregationFunctions
entries.description:
List of aggregation functions available for this column.
Aggregation functions must be available in the `aggregationFunctions` prop of the `<DatagGrid />` component.

entries.name: align
entries.description: Align cell content.
entries.typeDescription: type GridAlignment

entries.name: cellClassName
entries.description: Class name added to cells in this column.

entries.name: colSpan
entries.description: Number of columns a cell should span.
entries.typeDescription:
number | type GridColSpanFn<R, V, F>
---
number | 
function colSpan (
  value: V,
  row: R,
  column: GridColDef<R, V, F>,
  apiRef: RefObject<GridApiCommunity>,
) => number | undefined

entries.name: description
entries.description: The tooltip text shown when the column header name is truncated.

entries.name: disableColumnManagement
entries.description: If `true`, the column is not manageable by the column manager.

entries.name: disableColumnMenu
entries.description: If `true`, the column menu is disabled for this column.

entries.name: disableExport
entries.description: If `true`, this column will not be included in exports.

entries.name: disableReorder
entries.description: If `true`, this column cannot be reordered.

entries.name: display
entries.description:
Display mode for the cell:
 - 'text': For text-based cells (default)
 - 'flex': For cells with HTMLElement children

entries.name: editable
entries.description: If `true`, the cells of the column are editable.

entries.name: filterable
entries.description: If `true`, the column is filterable.

entries.name: filterOperators
entries.description: Allows setting the filter operators for this column.
entries.typeDescription:
Array<{
  getApplyFilterFn: GetApplyFilterFn<R, V, F>,
  value: string,
  label?: string,
  headerLabel?: string,
  InputComponent?: React.JSXElementConstructor<I>,
  InputComponentProps?: Partial<I>,
  getValueAsString?: (value: GridFilterItem["value"]) => string,
  requiresFilterValue?: boolean
}>

entries.name: flex
entries.description: The flex grow factor of the column. Must be a positive number.

entries.name: getApplyQuickFilterFn
entries.description:
The callback that generates a filtering function for a given quick filter value.
This function can return `null` to skip filtering for this value and column.

tags.param: apiRef Deprecated: The API of the grid.
tags.returns: The function to call to check if a row pass this filter value or not.

entries.name: getSortComparator
entries.description:
Provide an alternative comparator function for sorting.
Takes precedence over `sortComparator`.

tags.param: sortDirection The direction of the sort.

entries.typeDescription:
function getSortComparator (sortDirection: GridSortDirection) =>
  GridComparatorFn<V> | undefined;

entries.name: groupable
entries.description: If `true`, the rows can be grouped based on this column values.

entries.name: groupingValueGetter
entries.description: Function that returns a value to be used in grouping rows.

entries.name: headerAlign
entries.description: Align column header content.
entries.typeDescription: type GridAlignment

entries.name: headerClassName
entries.description: Class name added to the column header cell.
entries.typeDescription:
type GridColumnHeaderClassNamePropType
---
string | 
function headerClassName (params: GridColumnHeaderParams) => string

entries.name: headerName
entries.description: The title displayed in the column header cell.

entries.name: hideable
entries.description: If `false`, removes the option to hide this column.

entries.name: hideSortIcons
entries.description: Toggle the visibility of the sort icons.

entries.name: maxWidth
entries.description: The maximum width of the column in pixels.

entries.name: minWidth
entries.description: The minimum width of the column in pixels.

entries.name: pinnable
entries.description: If `false`, the menu items for column pinning menu will not be rendered.

entries.name: preProcessEditCellProps
entries.description:
Callback fired when the edit props of the cell changes.
Processes the props before being saved into the state.

tags.param: params Object containing parameters of the cell being edited.

entries.name: renderCell
entries.description: Override the component rendered as cell for this column.

tags.param: params Object containing parameters for the renderer.

entries.name: renderCellProps
entries.description: Additional `props` passed to the `renderCell` function. Useful for custom cells. Not used by the default cell type primitives.
entries.typeDescription: Record<string, any>

entries.name: renderEditCell
entries.description: Override the component rendered in edit cell mode for this column.

tags.param: params Object containing parameters for the renderer.

entries.name: renderHeader
entries.description: Override the component rendered in the column header cell.

tags.param: params Object containing parameters for the renderer.

entries.name: resizable
entries.description: If `false`, disables resizing for this column.

entries.name: rowSpanValueGetter
entries.description: Function that returns a specific value to be used in row spanning.

entries.name: sortable
entries.description: If `false`, disables sorting for this column.

entries.name: sortComparator
entries.description: A comparator function used to sort rows.

entries.name: sortingOrder
entries.description: The order of the sorting sequence.
entries.typeDescription: readonly GridSortDirection[]

entries.name: type
entries.description: The type of the column.

tags.see: See {@link https://mui.com/x/react-data-grid/column-definition/#column-types column types docs} for more details.

entries.typeDescription: type GridColType

entries.name: valueFormatter
entries.description: Formats the cell value before rendering.

entries.name: valueGetter
entries.description: Function that returns specific data to render in the cell instead of using the field value.

entries.name: valueParser
entries.description: Function that takes the user-entered value and converts it to a value used internally.

tags.returns: The converted value to use internally.

entries.name: valueSetter
entries.description:
Function that customizes how the entered value is stored in the row.
Only works with cell/row editing.

tags.returns: The row with the updated field.

entries.name: width
entries.description: The width of the column in pixels.
